scenario: Negative control: a dead function with a globally unique name, alongside an unrelated, differently-named function passed by reference to a framework registration call. Confirms the escape mechanism is name-scoped, not repo-scoped.
human_note: pkg.orphan2.orphan_target is never called or imported, and its name never appears anywhere else in the repository. other_handler is a distinct, differently-named function that is called directly and passed by reference to app.on_event(...); this only adds 'other_handler' to the escape set, not 'orphan_target'. Confirms D3's escape check does not over-fire on an unrelated repo simply because some other name is being passed around by reference.
